LightningComponentBundle.description: Simple component to run the Get Prices callout with platform event handling for Screen Flows

property.name: recordId
property.label: Quote Record ID
property.description: The ID of the quote record to fetch prices for

property.name: quoteName
property.label: Quote Name
property.description: The name of the quote (optional, for display purposes)

property.name: quoteRegion
property.label: Quote Region
property.description: The region of the quote (optional, for display purposes)

property.name: canProceed
property.label: Can Proceed
property.description: Whether the flow can proceed to the next step (true after successful price fetch)

property.name: isLoading
property.label: Is Loading
property.description: Whether the component is currently loading/processing

property.name: errorMessage
property.label: Error Message
property.description: Error message if any error occurred

property.name: priceCalloutSuccess
property.label: Price Callout Success
property.description: Whether the price callout was successful
